feature_interaction_definition: mean over every non-empty matched background S excluding i,j of f(S+i+j)-f(S+i)-f(S+j)+f(S); positive denotes positive predictive interaction/complementarity, values near zero denote approximately additive effects, and negative denotes negative interaction/antagonism or diminishing returns; negative interaction is not interpreted as redundancy by this score alone
marginal_contribution_definition: for each feature f in the final selected Phase 3 feature set, over every non-empty background subset S containing only other selected features: delta=f(S+f)-f(S); the empty background is excluded because no zero-feature model exists in the exhaustive Phase 3 table
marginal_contribution_scope: focal features and background features are restricted strictly to Recommended_Final_Feature_Set.csv for this case
